data.title: TAE Infrastructure Rotation Detection
data.description: Detect Threat Actor Ecosystem (TAE) infrastructure rotation patterns used by bulletproof hosting providers to evade sanctions and takedowns: (1) IP prefix transfers between related Autonomous Systems within short timeframes, (2) RIPE NCC resource reallocation to newly created organizations with minimal operational history, (3) BGP announcement changes matching known TAE rebranding patterns such as Aeza to Hypercore to NetCrafters, (4) threat density score spikes on newly announced prefixes indicating migration of malicious infrastructure to fresh address space.

detection.condition: (selection_prefix_transfer and selection_new_org) or selection_threat_density or (selection_prefix_transfer and selection_rebranding)

enrichment_required.source: Threat intelligence enrichment (IP prefix threat density calculation)
BGP analytics enrichment (infrastructure overlap between old and new ASN announcements)

falsepositives: Legitimate ISP mergers and acquisitions involving prefix transfers
Planned infrastructure migrations with proper documentation
